notes.title: Patch 2021.1.6 (v13)
notes.notes:
- Champion of the day released. Now you can win gold. You will receive 250 gold for a win and 180, 150, 120, 100, 80, 60, 40, 20, and 10 gold for the following places. Finally, you can gain 10 gold for the fastest lap.
- Improved filter for abusive messages and nicknames. It now should not be possible to see any in the UI.
- New championship leaderboard is introduced. It is based on the "champion of the day" mode. Every Sunday, the results of the champion of the day are counted towards the championship. It lasts two months and consists of 8-9 races. It is currently in BETA, and there are currently NO rewards planned for this first one.

notes.title: Patch 2021.1.5
notes.notes:
- New game mode: Champion of the day
- The mode is in open Beta testing.
- To participate in the game mode, you need to select Gen 8 vehicle and click "Champion of the day" in the "Other game modes" tab.
- The mode happens once a day, always at 8 p.m. CET; you can see the countdown when you select the mode.
- The game consists of 10 min qualifying and about 10 min race.
- Once the game mode starts, you don't need to click anything; just wait and race.
- Gold WILL be awarded once the game mode is tested.

Please keep in mind that the mode is still in the testing, so make sure to report any bugs or any ideas for improvement. Also, keep in mind that the release of this mode was a little bit rushed to introduce all features of Engine Evolution 2022 early and have more time to debug them.

notes.title: Patch 2021.1.2 (v2)
notes.notes: Since I am nearly at the end of my study, it is really the time to either make this game my living or throw it in the bin. Since I don't want to make the game pay to win or anything like that, I partnered with Anzu, a startup for marketing inside games. They showed me a small demo how their ads in games look like, and I immediately decided that I should try that. Hence, I uploaded the first test version of the in-game ads today. Of course, everything is subject to change, so try the game, especially the map [b]Wooden Hill[/b], and let me know what you think in the Google form: https://forms.gle/68o19xS3PB46z9Mw7 Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Patch 2021.0.10 (v4)
notes.notes:

- Refactoring to road drawing system: there will be many new features in the future, first one is that flags are now aligned with the wind.
- You cannot reverse before qualifying to gain more speed. Although it was not cheating, it was not sportsmanship behavior. You are still allowed to start the lap when you want.
- There are prototypes of several new maps available in practice mode. You can try them and review them.
- There will be fewer patches in the next few days since I am doing a lot of refactoring.
